name: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis — FRED
attribution: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis. Series retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis. Held only for the conversation and never stored, as FRED's terms require.
notes: Terms forbid storing FRED content: every FRED row is cache=session. Rejects a browser-shaped User-Agent with no browser behind it.

name: European Central Bank
attribution: Source: European Central Bank. ECB statistics may be reproduced and distributed free of charge provided the ECB is cited as the source; any Bedrok-computed transformation of an ECB series is stated as such.
notes: Rejects the SDMX-CSV Accept header with 406; format=csvdata returns its own CSV (KEY column, no DATAFLOW). 503s some default client agents. SPF series are dated in the future.

name: Eurostat
attribution: Source: Eurostat. Reused under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (CC BY 4.0). Commercial reuse covers EU, EFTA and EU candidate countries only, so Bedrok carries no other country's data from Eurostat.
notes: JSON-stat 2.0. Data on countries outside the EU, EFTA and the EU candidate countries is outside the commercial reuse grant: curated families iterate their own list, and the broad HICP set keeps only pipeline.REUSE_GEOS.

name: U.S. Energy Information Administration
attribution: Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration. U.S. government work — public domain.
notes: 5,000 rows per response; deep daily series are paged.

name: Office for National Statistics
attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Source: Office for National Statistics.
notes: api.ons.gov.uk was decommissioned on 2024-11-25; the site path per series is the source_code.

name: Bank of England
attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Source: Bank of England. 'Bank of England' is a registered trade mark.
notes: IADB CSV, fetched in 15-year chunks; a span too long returns an HTML error page with HTTP 200.

name: OECD
attribution: Source: OECD. Reused under CC BY 4.0; cite as OECD (year), dataset, accessed via the OECD SDMX API.
notes: Pin every dimension. Rows come newest first. Cloudflare blocks some IPs; dataflow versions bump.

name: Federal Reserve Banks' research files and FHFA
attribution: Source: research data of the Federal Reserve Banks of New York, Chicago, Cleveland, Dallas, Atlanta and Philadelphia, and the Federal Housing Finance Agency. New York Fed content is subject to the Terms of Use at newyorkfed.org. The Chicago, Cleveland, Dallas and Atlanta Feds permit reuse only with credit and not for gain; the Philadelphia Fed reserves all rights. ACM term premium: Adrian, Crump & Moench (2013). Weekly Economic Index: Lewis, Mertens & Stock, www.dallasfed.org/research/wei.
notes: Licence is per catalog row: NY Fed attribution; Chicago, Cleveland, Dallas, Atlanta noncommercial; Philadelphia personal_use; FHFA public domain.

name: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
attribution: Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, statistical releases H.15, H.10, G.17, H.6, H.8, H.4.1, SLOOS and charge-off and delinquency rates. U.S. government work — public domain.
notes: One SDMX-XML zip per release. The Board is retiring its Data Download Program and points users at FRED.

name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
attribution: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. U.S. government work — public domain.
notes: Keyless: 25 requests a day. Key: 500, and it expires yearly.

name: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis
attribution: Source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis. U.S. government work — public domain.
notes: 100 requests and 30 errors a minute per key.

name: U.S. Census Bureau
attribution: Source: U.S. Census Bureau. U.S. government work — public domain. This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau.
notes: Needs time_slot_id and for=us:* on most datasets; the error URL carries the key.

name: Federal Reserve Bank of New York — Markets Data and surveys
attribution: Source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York. Content from the New York Fed is subject to the Terms of Use at newyorkfed.org, including those for its reference rates (SOFR).
notes: 403s a default client agent.

name: The World Bank — Commodity Markets (Pink Sheet)
attribution: Source: The World Bank — Commodity Markets ('Pink Sheet'). Reused under CC BY 4.0.
notes: Bulk monthly workbook.

name: U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission — Commitments of Traders
attribution: Source: U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission, Commitments of Traders. U.S. government work — public domain.
notes: Yearly zip archives; none exists for a new year until its first report.

name: Bedrok (computed from stored series)
attribution: Computed by Bedrok from stored series; the transformation is Bedrok's, not the original publisher's. The inputs' own sources are credited alongside.
notes: Arithmetic on stored inputs; NBER business-cycle dates for the recession flag.

name: Bank for International Settlements
attribution: Source: Bank for International Settlements (BIS) statistics, data.bis.org. Under the BIS terms of permitted use of statistics: the BIS is cited as the source, and including them in a commercial product must not add to its price.
notes: Statistics may be used with citation; in a commercial product they must not add to the price. Most BIS series are compiled from national central banks, whose own terms may be tighter.

name: International Monetary Fund
attribution: Source: International Monetary Fund. Not to be used to train large language models without the IMF's permission (IMF Copyright and Usage terms). Any transformation by Bedrok is stated with the series.
notes: Use the 2.1 path: 3.0 ignores startPeriod and returns SDMX-CSV 2.0. Periods look like 2026-M06. The IMF does not permit use of its content to train large language models without permission; Bedrok stores and retrieves, it does not train.

name: Istituto Nazionale di Statistica (Istat)
attribution: Source: Istat. Reused under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence (CC BY 4.0); changes are Bedrok's and are stated.
notes: Many datasets carry an EDITION dimension: pin it or a key returns several vintages. Rate-limits by IP; the dataflow list is slow and large.

name: Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques (INSEE)
attribution: Source : Insee. Reused under the Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0 (Etalab).
notes: SDMX-ML only (StructureSpecificData), newest first. Series are addressed by their BDM id under SERIES_BDM. x-rate-limit-limit: 100.

name: Australian Bureau of Statistics
attribution: Source: Australian Bureau of Statistics. Reused under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (CC BY 4.0).
notes: No data is a 404 with body NoRecordsFound. Dataflow versions (e.g. CPI,2.0.0) bump when a structure changes, breaking a pinned request.

name: Bank of Canada
attribution: Source: Bank of Canada (Valet API), reused under its terms of use; changes are Bedrok's and are stated. Not endorsed by the Bank of Canada.
notes: Whole series in one request. The terms forbid getting round the Valet API's request limits, and §1.3 requires telling buyers the data are free on the Bank's site if they are ever resold.

name: Statistics Canada
attribution: Source: Statistics Canada. Reproduced and distributed on an "as is" basis under the Statistics Canada Open Licence; where transformed, adapted from Statistics Canada, and this does not constitute an endorsement by Statistics Canada.
notes: Series addressed by vector id, which survives a table redesign; table coordinates do not. Soft limit about 25 requests a second.

name: Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE)
attribution: Fuente: INE (www.ine.es), reused under CC BY 4.0; transformations are Bedrok's own (elaboración propia con datos del INE).
notes: Series codes are retired on a rebase and the old code keeps answering with frozen data: IPC251852 stopped at 2025-12, EPA815 at 2023-Q4. Read periods from Anyo/FK_Periodo, not Fecha.

name: Statistics Sweden (SCB)
attribution: Source: Statistics Sweden. Open data released under CC0; credited as a courtesy.
notes: PxWebApi 2. Tables are replaced, not revised, when a base year or classification changes: CPIF 1987=100 (TAB5919) stopped at 2025M12. Call limits per 10 seconds per IP.

name: Statistics Norway (SSB)
attribution: Source: Statistics Norway (SSB), reused under CC BY 4.0; changes are Bedrok's and are stated.
notes: PxWebApi 2. SSB lists replaced and discontinued tables under "Changes to tables in Statbank".

name: Statistics Finland
attribution: Source: Statistics Finland, reused under CC BY 4.0; changes are Bedrok's and are stated.
notes: PxWeb 1 (POST a JSON query). Table paths are the short id, khi/11xs.px; the long statfin_khi_pxt_ form answers 400. Cell limits per query.

name: Statistics Denmark
attribution: Source: Statistics Denmark (statbank.dk), reused under its terms, which correspond to CC BY 4.0.
notes: Statbank's own API, answering JSON-stat. Latest data only, no vintages. Its terms do not cover Danmarks Nationalbank's tables. PRIS111 (2015=100) stopped at 2025M12; PRIS01 carries the CPI on.

name: Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis)
attribution: Source: Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis), GENESIS-Online, Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung – Version 2.0 (www.govdata.de/dl-de/by-2-0); data changed by Bedrok where stated.
notes: Free token, sent as the username header, never in a URL. The guest login no longer returns data. A table too big to cut directly answers Status 98 (job required): narrow it with classifying keys. The login check echoes the token back, so never print it.

name: Statistics Bureau of Japan / e-Stat
attribution: Source: Portal Site of Official Statistics of Japan (e-Stat, https://www.e-stat.go.jp/), Statistics Bureau, Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications; processed by Bedrok.
notes: Free application id, a URL parameter (redacted from errors). Each CPI base year is a new table carrying the linked history; the old one stops. The seasonally adjusted Labour Force Survey series are not in the API database.

name: Ministry of Finance, Japan
attribution: Source: Ministry of Finance, Japan, JGB interest rates (https://www.mof.go.jp/), reused under the Public Data License 1.0; processed by Bedrok.
notes: Two Shift-JIS CSV files: the history to the end of last month, and the current month. "-" where a tenor was not quoted (the 10-year starts in 1986).
